title: The Remembrancer's Companion
summary: A companion for those past the courses that fixes every detail of a scene for good and lifts the fog from a clouded mind.

title: Treatise on the Standing Echo of the Past
summary: A treatise on the memory that a place keeps of everything done in it and on drawing that memory up to fight in the present.

title: The Skysworn Recall Canon
summary: A canon of the cultivation-side order on drilling a whole company to share one memory of the orders and to act on it as one.

title: Manual of the Sapphire Record
summary: A manual of a clear blue record kept of everything seen that can be replayed in the mind and sealed against all forgetting.

title: The Pledge-Keeping Memory Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the memory that holds every pledge given and taken and seals a broken pledge against the one who broke it.

title: The Storm-Kept Chronicle Treatise
summary: A treatise on chronicling a storm of events in the mind as they happen and on casting that written storm back at the foe.
